description: Mediation Boards Commission - Notice calling for nominations for the Appointment of Mediators
categorisation: This gazette content is a public service recruitment notice calling for nominations to appoint mediators to various Mediation Boards across administrative districts. It falls under public sector administration and recruitment matters, specifically dealing with the appointment process for these public service positions, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized categories (4-7, 9).
